title: Mobile Laboratory Casework - Pathology Lab Reno Phs2 Togus VAMC
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.241-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 01 (36C241)
description_text: Togus VAMC requires furnished and installed mobile laboratory casework for its renovated Pathology Laboratory. Laboratory casework consists of specialized cabinets, benches, and storage systems designed for chemical resistance, durability, and compliance with laboratory safety standards. The basis of design is the Optima 2011 mobile steel casework manufactured by Mott Manufacturing Ltd., with shelving and hanging cabinets. This requirement is brand-name or equal.
